changelog: The schedule start can now be set precisely, with a one-click suggestion for a convenient full-hour start. The content preview now follows the server's source, interleave and shuffle order; selected starting titles are retained, and weekly blocks are easier to distinguish in the schedule.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
